# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

The root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) is the authoritative shared instruction source for Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex. Read it before acting, along with [`docs/coordination/PROJECT_STATUS.md`](../docs/coordination/PROJECT_STATUS.md), [`docs/coordination/CURRENT_TASKS.md`](../docs/coordination/CURRENT_TASKS.md), and [`docs/coordination/AGENT_HANDOFF.md`](../docs/coordination/AGENT_HANDOFF.md). Inspect Git status and branch before editing.

Apply the shared rules for task ownership, tests and evidence, cryptographic/security caution, preservation of research, documentation, and Git safety. If a local instruction conflicts with `AGENTS.md`, stop and ask the project owner rather than silently choosing a policy. The existence of this file does not itself prove that Copilot loaded it; use Copilot Chat's instruction/reference UI to verify activation.
